workers.name: František Kunc

workers.name: Milan Komár
workers.quote_cs: Padne to nebo ne?

workers.name: Máňa
workers.quote_cs: Tak, hoši, do práce.
workers.quote_en: Right then, lads. Back to work.

workers.name: Strejda Káninský
workers.quote_cs: To se dělá takhle. Ne tak.
workers.quote_en: This is how it's done. Not like that.

workers.name: Jirka Formař
workers.quote_cs: Forma musí sedět. Jinak to nefoukneš.
workers.quote_en: The mould must fit. Or you can't blow it.
